Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.d@silverlinecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Silverline CAIQ dry run request

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Were starting our vendor intake for SOC 2 and SIG and would like to do a CAIQ dry run to align on answers and identify any evidence gaps before the formal questionnaire.

Can your team do a 60-minute dry run next week (week of 6/28)? Key asks from our side:
- Walk through our CAIQ draft answers for scope items we called out (data residency, logging, key mgmt).
- Confirm sample logs and the extraction window youll need for validation.
- Quick review of any control statements where were expecting a Redwood-provided artifact (config snapshot, architecture diagram).

Attachments: weve included an initial artifact list (silverline_requested_artifacts.csv) and the CAIQ spreadsheet we received from your team last week.

Recording consent: procurement needs explicit consent for recording the session; weve attached their doc (procurement consent form) — is Redwood OK to record the dry run for internal audit?

Proposed slots:
- Wed 6/30 10:00-11:00 PT
- Thu 7/1 09:00-10:00 PT
- Fri 7/2 11:00-12:00 PT

If those dont work we can shift.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Security Programs Lead | Silverline Cloud
T: +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: silverline_requested_artifacts.csv, procurement_consent_form.pdf

Irene / Marissa / Ben —

Looping you in on Silverlines ask. They want a 60-min CAIQ dry run to validate answers + confirm evidence cadence. High level plan:
1) 10m intro and scope confirmation (Alex)
2) 30m CAIQ walkthrough with focus on logging, keys, and data residency (Irene + Marissa)
3) 15m artifacts expected + log sampling window (Ben)
4) 5m next steps / action owners (all)

Can you confirm:
- Availability for Thu 7/1 09:00-10:00 PT (preferred by them) — call in 1 hour if possible.
- Who will own the following evidence items: architecture diagram (Marissa?), config snapshots (Irene?), log pull runbook/sample (Ben).
- We should send a short agenda and a recording consent PDF to Priya if were OK with recording. Ill draft the agenda and a brief run-of-show.

I attached a quick intake sheet (redwood intake) Ill populate with owners once you confirm.

Thanks —
Alex
